title: Membership age bands
statementMd:
Label each member by years since joining as of 2024-07-01: `new` (under 1 year), `regular` (1 to under 3), `veteran` (3 or more). Count members per label.

Expected columns: `label`, `members`.

Tables: `authors`, `books`, `members`, `loans`.

Row order does not matter.
solutionMd:
```sql
SELECT CASE WHEN (julianday('2024-07-01') - julianday(joined)) / 365.25 < 1 THEN 'new' WHEN (julianday('2024-07-01') - julianday(joined)) / 365.25 < 3 THEN 'regular' ELSE 'veteran' END AS label, COUNT(*) AS members FROM members GROUP BY label;
```

Compare with your own query; the result sets must match.
